definitions.explanation: being remarkably superior to others in ability, achievement, or quality

examples.japanese: {傑出|けっしゅつ}した{才能|さいのう}を{持|も}つ。
{彼|かれ}は{傑出|けっしゅつ}した{科学者|かがくしゃ}だった。
{傑出|けっしゅつ}した{業績|ぎょうせき}で{歴史|れきし}に{名|な}を{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: He left his name in history through outstanding achievements.

examples.japanese: この{分野|ぶんや}で{傑出|けっしゅつ}した{人物|じんぶつ}は{数少|かずすく}ない。
examples.english: There are few distinguished figures in this field.

notes:
{傑出|けっしゅつ} describes someone or something remarkably superior to others, used to praise exceptional ability or achievement.

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {傑|けつ} (outstanding person, hero)
- {出|しゅつ} (come out, emerge)

USAGE:
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}する (to be outstanding - suru verb)
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}した〜 (outstanding ~, distinguished ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}した{人物|じんぶつ} (distinguished person)
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}した{才能|さいのう} (outstanding talent)
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}した{業績|ぎょうせき} (distinguished achievements)
- {傑出|けっしゅつ}した{作品|さくひん} (outstanding work)

REGISTER:
- Formal/written style
- Common in biographical descriptions, awards, and academic contexts
- High praise, often for historical figures or exceptional individuals

SIMILAR TERMS:
- {卓越|たくえつ} - excellence (more about ability/quality)
- {秀逸|しゅういつ} - excellent, superb
- {出色|しゅっしょく} - outstanding, remarkable

RELATED TERMS:
- {卓越|たくえつ} (excellence, preeminence)
- {優秀|ゆうしゅう} (excellent, superior)
- {抜群|ばつぐん} (outstanding, preeminent)
- {偉大|いだい} (great, mighty)
